## 2. Production Performance Benchmarks & Measurement Context

- **< 5ms Core Dynamic Tariff Latency**:
  - *Measurement Context*: Measured as the end-to-end evaluation time from vehicle entry event through in-memory fee lookup, concession matrices, and tax calculation under live toll lane transaction load.
- **Sub-200ms WebRTC Video Streaming Latency**:
  - *Measurement Context*: Measured glass-to-glass latency from IP camera H.264/H.265 RTSP streams ingested into MediaMTX and served via WebRTC (WHEP) into operator web consoles with ONVIF PTZ control.
- **150+ Monitored Highway Lane Devices**:
  - *Measurement Context*: Active production scale across multiple national highway toll plazas in India, capturing real-time device health heartbeats (barrier status, loop detectors, IP cameras, thermal printers) via distributed SignalR WebSockets.
- **99.9% System Availability & SLA**:
  - *Measurement Context*: Maintained via fault-tolerant Windows Services with local SQLite/JSON transactional disk caching for seamless offline lane operations during central network outages.

## 3. Deep-Dive System Architectures & Case Studies

### 1. ParkAOT (ParkOS) — Smart Parking & POS Automation
- **Domain**: Automated Parking Infrastructure, POS Automation, Dynamic Pricing.
- **Tech Stack**: ASP.NET Core 8 MVC, C#, PostgreSQL 16, SignalR WebSockets, FastReport .NET, Python YOLOv8 / PaddleOCR, Device Service APIs.
- **Architecture**:
  - *Frontend & Operator UI*: High-speed entry/exit point-of-sale console with live camera stream preview and automatic plate OCR lookup.
  - *Dynamic Tariff Engine*: Evaluates multi-tier duration, vehicle category (2W/4W/Commercial), and peak-hour pricing in <5ms.
  - *Device Service Orchestration*: Communicates with internal device microservices to trigger boom barrier operations, request 80mm thermal receipt printing for QR barcode slips, drive LED User Fare Displays, and stream live camera feeds.
  - *Financial Reconciliation*: Role-based shift management with automated FastReport MIS revenue audits.

### 2. ANPR Multi-Lane Central Monitoring & Plaza Telemetry
- **Domain**: Central Highway Toll Command & Real-Time Device Health Monitoring.
- **Tech Stack**: ASP.NET Core Web API, PostgreSQL, SignalR, Leaflet.js, Windows Services.
- **Architecture**:
  - *3-Tier Distributed Topology*: Lane Processing Unit (LPU) &rarr; Toll Plaza Local Server &rarr; Central Command HQ.
  - *Telemetry Stream*: Ingests high-frequency vehicle transaction payloads and device health heartbeats across 150+ monitored lanes.
  - *Corridor GIS Map*: Visualizes plaza connectivity, lane status alarms, and real-time transit throughput using Leaflet.js and live WebSockets.

### 3. Vehicle Re-Identification & Visual Search Engine
- **Domain**: Computer Vision, Deep Metric Learning, Cross-Camera Tracking.
- **Tech Stack**: Python 3.11, PyTorch, OSNet, FAISS (Facebook AI Similarity Search), OpenCV, FastAPI.
- **Architecture**:
  - *Feature Extraction*: Generates 512-dimensional L2-normalized embeddings from vehicle crops using an OSNet backbone fine-tuned for high-speed highway camera angles.
  - *Vector Search*: Utilizes FAISS index for sub-15ms similarity search across historical captures to match vehicles even during license plate occlusion or tampering.
  - *Windshield ROI Analysis*: Performs MSER blob detection on windshield zones (FASTag stickers, emblems, tinting) for fine-grained secondary validation.

### 4. NEXTGEN Consolidated Highway ATMS
- **Domain**: Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) & Roadway Safety.
- **Tech Stack**: C#, .NET Core / .NET Framework, PostgreSQL, Windows Services, Leaflet GIS, RDLC Reporting.
- **Architecture**:
  - *Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)*: Unifies disparate roadside subsystems including Variable Message Signs (VMS), Automatic Traffic Counters (ATCC), Emergency Call Boxes (ECB), Meteorological Weather Stations, and CCTV cameras.
  - *Background Ingestion*: Fault-tolerant Windows Services poll and parse sensor telemetry, persisting standardized events to PostgreSQL and pushing critical safety alarms.

### 5. Video Management System (VMS) & Multi-Camera PTZ Engine
- **Domain**: IP Surveillance, Low-Latency Video Streaming, Camera Control.
- **Tech Stack**: C#, ASP.NET Core, MediaMTX, WebRTC (WHEP), ONVIF Protocol, RTSP.
- **Architecture**:
  - *Device Discovery & Management*: Direct ONVIF integration implementing WS-Discovery, media profiles, PTZ continuous/absolute positioning, and preset patrol loops.
  - *Low-Latency Streaming*: MediaMTX streaming pipeline converting RTSP streams into sub-200ms WebRTC feeds for responsive operator camera steering without buffer lag.
  - *Synchronized Timeline Playback*: Multi-channel synchronized timeline scrubber for incident investigations.

### 6. Edge-Based ANPR & Automatic Traffic Classifier (ATCC)
- **Domain**: Embedded Edge AI, Real-Time Traffic Classification.
- **Tech Stack**: Python 3.11, YOLOv8, PaddleOCR (Fine-Tuned), NCNN, OpenVINO, ByteTrack, Raspberry Pi 5.
- **Architecture**:
  - *Edge Execution*: Quantized YOLO + PaddleOCR running locally on Raspberry Pi 5 at 15+ FPS.
  - *Plate Specialization*: Custom character dictionaries trained on 5,000+ Indian vehicle plates (98% character accuracy).
  - *Live Demo*: Deployed on Hugging Face Spaces (https://huggingface.co/spaces/parthpatil0024/ANPR).

### 7. ATMS Progressive Web App & Mobile Diagnostic Console
- **Domain**: Mobile Field Operations & Roadside Maintenance.
- **Tech Stack**: PWA, JavaScript ES6+, Service Workers, Bootstrap 5, .NET Core Web API, PostgreSQL.
- **Architecture**:
  - *Technician Field Console*: Mobile UI for inspecting lane device heartbeats and reviewing live camera snapshots.
  - *Offline Caching*: Service Worker caching for device manuals and audit logging in zero-connectivity highway stretches.
